causal_findings: J3 was not a localization failure: both matched arms reached the human-fix file early and repeatedly.
The human repair is a one-statement progress update before an early return.
Neither the scalar A2 grammar nor the frozen J3 structural grammar can synthesize insertion of an existing source-local progress operation into control flow.
J3 therefore isolates a progress/control-flow expressivity bottleneck after J1 search starvation and J2 structural-edit expressivity.
claim_boundary: J3 remains a valid negative. The revealed fix diagnoses the next machinery gap and may not be used to reclassify or retune J3 into a pass.
next_development_change: Add a generic Java progress-step insertion operator that mines source-local cursor/progress operations and proposes them before early exits in compatible control-flow contexts, without encoding Lang-43 file/class/method/identifier names or human patch text. Qualify only on a fresh deterministic J4 case.
